title: The Dinosaurs Didn't Go Far
subtitle: The sparrows in the yard are their children
character: wearing a green short sleeve t-shirt and dark blue shorts, white socks and grey sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, warm vintage storybook art, soft gouache painting, earthy ochre and deep green palette, gentle textured brushwork, soft natural light

pages.zh:
博物馆里，站着一只好大好大的恐龙。
它只剩下骨头了。
我想问问它：
「你们都去哪儿了？」
pages.scene: A little boy stands in a quiet dinosaur museum hall with a polished stone floor, tilting his head all the way back to look up at an enormous mounted dinosaur fossil skeleton made only of pale bones, with empty eye sockets and bare ribs, standing on a low display platform and towering over him. Warm light comes through tall windows. The boy is small at the bottom of the frame, the skeleton fills the upper space.
pages.en:
At the museum, there's a great big dinosaur.
Only its bones are left.
I want to ask it,
“Where did you all go?”

pages.zh:
很久很久以前，
地球上到处都是恐龙。
那时候还没有人，
也没有我。
pages.scene: A wide prehistoric landscape with several large dinosaurs walking among giant ferns and tall conifer trees, a volcano smoking far away on the horizon. Misty morning light. No people, no buildings.
pages.en:
A long, long time ago,
there were dinosaurs all over the Earth.
There were no people yet,
and no me, either.

pages.zh:
有的恐龙比房子还高，
脖子长得能够到树顶。
有的恐龙却和一只鸡差不多大。
pages.scene: A very tall long necked dinosaur reaching the top of a tree on the left, and on the right a small chicken sized dinosaur standing on the ground looking up at it. The size difference between them is dramatic. Green prehistoric forest.
pages.en:
Some dinosaurs were taller than a house,
with necks long enough to reach the treetops.
But some were only about as big as a chicken.

pages.zh:
咦？这只小恐龙，
穿着毛茸茸的衣服。
像小鸡一样。
pages.scene: Close up of a small fluffy feathered dinosaur the size of a chicken, standing among ferns. Its body is covered in soft downy feathers, but it has a long tail and clawed feet like a dinosaur. Curious and gentle expression.
pages.en:
Huh? This little dinosaur
is wearing a fluffy coat.
Just like a baby chick.

pages.zh:
有一天，天上掉下来一颗大石头。
比一座山还大。
pages.scene: A huge glowing meteor falling through a darkening sky above the prehistoric landscape, leaving a bright trail of fire. Dinosaurs below look up. Dramatic orange and dark blue sky.
pages.en:
One day, a huge rock fell out of the sky.
It was bigger than a mountain.

pages.zh:
轰——
天黑了。
太阳躲起来了。
好冷。
pages.scene: A still, grey prehistoric landscape under a dim sky thick with dust, bare broken trees and scattered rocks, soft grey ash drifting down like snow and covering the ground. Cold muted colors, faint dim light. Nobody is there, only trees, rocks and falling ash.
pages.en:
BOOM—
The sky went dark.
The sun hid away.
It was so cold.

pages.zh:
大恐龙们，一个一个都不见了。
可是有一些小小的、有羽毛的恐龙，
躲在洞里，活了下来。
pages.scene: Inside a small cozy burrow under a big tree root, two little fluffy feathered dinosaurs covered in soft orange and cream downy feathers, with long tails, huddle close together to keep warm. Through the burrow opening behind them the outside world is grey and covered in ash. Warm soft light inside the hole.
pages.en:
One by one, the big dinosaurs disappeared.
But some small, feathered dinosaurs
hid in holes and survived.

pages.zh:
太阳又出来了。
小恐龙的孩子，孩子的孩子，
羽毛越长越长，
有一天，它们飞了起来。
pages.scene: A sequence in one picture: a small feathered dinosaur on the ground on the left, a similar creature spreading longer feathered arms in the middle, and on the right it lifts off the ground into the air. Green landscape returning to life, sunlight breaking through.
pages.en:
The sun came back out.
The little dinosaurs' children, and their children's children,
grew longer and longer feathers,
and one day, they flew.

pages.zh:
那就是——鸟！
鸟是恐龙的孩子。
恐龙没有走远。
它们一直都在。
pages.scene: A small brown sparrow perched on a branch in bright daylight, seen close up, with a faint soft silhouette of a feathered dinosaur behind it in the background like a memory. Warm sunny sky.
pages.en:
They became—birds!
Birds are the dinosaurs' children.
The dinosaurs didn't go far.
They've been here all along.

pages.zh:
我在院子里放了一些面包屑。
麻雀飞下来吃。
我小声说：
「你好呀，小恐龙。」
pages.scene: A little boy crouching in his backyard holding out a hand with breadcrumbs, several sparrows landing on the ground in front of him to eat. Warm afternoon light, green grass, the boy is smiling gently.
pages.en:
I put some bread crumbs out in the yard.
The sparrows fly down to eat.
I whisper,
“Hello, little dinosaurs.”
